## Findings
- claim-1: For \(m\ge1\), the source takes \(n=4m\), \(r=n-r=2m\), \(i=j=m\), hence \(a=b=m\), but states that \(J_v\) requires \(\binom{2m}{m}\) generators only “according to Conjecture 4.10.” [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 938-955]
- claim-2: Let \(A_m=H^\star(GL_{4m}/B,\mathbb Z)\), \(v_m=v_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}\), and let \(w_m\) be the unique dissector partner of \(v_m\). Then \[ J_{v_m}^{A_m}=I_{w_m}^{A_m},\qquad \mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m}^{A_m})=\mu_{A_m}(I_{w_m}^{A_m}), \] where \(\mu_A(L)\) is the minimum cardinality of a homogeneous \(A\)-generating set of \(L\).
- claim-3: No supplied internal theorem, with durable locator, proves \[ \mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m}^{A_m})=\binom{2m}{m}\quad(m\ge1). \] The supplied primary source instead makes this numerical assertion conditional on its conjecture.
## Strategy
The required numerical theorem is absent. The audit at `artifacts/internal-sources/ba093e9698dcd534de3dc53890f1b8d8396115df56ecc3710605037120fde810/artifact.txt@L26-L39` records no internal result proving
\[
\mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})=\binom{2m}{m}\quad(m\ge1).
\]
Source-30 instead makes this assertion conditional on Conjecture 4.10 [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 938-975].

The reduction does preserve generator number. For \(m\ge1\), let
\[
A_m=H^\star(GL_{4m}/B,\mathbb Z),\quad
v_m=v_{2m,2m,m+1,4m},
\]
and let \(w_m=w_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}\) be its unique dissector partner. The admissibility inequalities are
\[
1\le m+1\le2m,\qquad m+1>0.
\]
Also \(i=j=m\). The integral Schubert classes form a \(\mathbb Z\)-basis [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 61-66], and the dissector decomposition gives
\[
u\ge v_m\iff u\not\le w_m
\]
[doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 643-648, 664-683]. Hence, in the same graded ring \(A_m\),
\[
J_{v_m}^{A_m}
=\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v_m\}
=\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\not\le w_m\}
=I_{w_m}^{A_m}.
\]
Therefore their homogeneous generating sets are identical, so
\[
\mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m}^{A_m})=\mu_{A_m}(I_{w_m}^{A_m}).
\]

## Gaps
No durable internal theorem establishes the required numerical equality in \(A_m\). Thus the requested numerical certificate is **not established**; only the \(J_{v_m}\)-to-\(I_{w_m}\) generator-number preservation is established.

## Next
Required missing evidence: an immutable theorem or a proof certificate establishing, for every \(m\ge1\),
\[
\mu_{A_m}\!\left(\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v_m\}\right)
=\binom{2m}{m}.
\]
